title: News Coverage of Special Topics; Election '22: Daily Reporting Under Pressure I
description:
Prerequisite: JOUR320/JOUR360. JOUR389O must be taken concurrently with JOUR389P.

We will study the top news stories each day, analyzing the differences in coverage by three networks. This emphasizes reporting, writing, critical thinking, and journalistic judgments. Given our location, the course will focus on political/governmental news, but not exclusively.
